claims.exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign f under an interior product bias and every physical coordinate block A, the exact entropy decrement satisfies L_A=M_A+J_A with J_A=I(Z;S_B)>=0 and J_A<=M_A+sum_{i in A}[h2(p_i)+log2(max(p_i,1-p_i))]. Deterministic endpoints require deleting the deterministic coordinate before biased normalization.
hypotheses: all biases strictly between zero and one

proof_dependencies.role: entropy lower bound for two orthonormal bases

review_records.method: Independent reconstruction of the physical posterior channel, tensor orthogonal matrix, maximum overlap, entropy signs, zero fibers, and deterministic limits.

claims.first_unproved_line: A dimension-free influence or hierarchy payment for M_A+Delta_A remains open.

claims.exact_statement: For g(X,Y)=(-1)^(XY), independent P(X=1)=1/8 and P(Y=1)=1/4, with physical block A={X}, J_A-M_A>1195/10000 bits. Thus universal tax-free J_A<=M_A under arbitrary product biases is false.

review_records.method: Inspected exact masses, rational atanh remainder, signed four-corner quotient interval arithmetic, entropy bound reversal, and saved PASS output; unchanged certificate not rerun.

claims.exact_statement: For g(x,y)=(-1)^(xy), A={X}, fixed q=P(Y=1) in (0,1/2), and p=P(X=1) tending to zero, J_A-M_A=4q(1-2q)p log2(1/p)+O_q(p). In particular at q=1/4 any universal correction Gamma(p) in J_A<=M_A+Gamma(p) must satisfy liminf Gamma(p)/(p log2(1/p))>=1/2.
refutes: A universal valid scalar correction to J_A<=M_A can be O(p) at the rare endpoint.
claims.first_unproved_line: Whether the coefficient one in Delta(p) is optimal remains open.

claims.exact_statement: For multiplicative tensors f=f1*f2 on disjoint variables under product measures, with a physical restriction block split as A=A1 union A2, the B09 quantities M,J,L and Delta add across factors. This does not establish their additivity or nonreused payment through an arbitrary Boolean composition F(g1,...,gk), and it gives no shared-variable closure.
hypotheses: physical restriction block split across factors
refutes: O'Donnell-Tan alone makes the B09 M,J,Delta ledger additive through arbitrary Boolean composition.
claims.first_unproved_line: A gate-to-inner-physical-restriction transfer identity with nonreused tax remains open.
